G4012.def:
**περί**,
_prep._ with genitive, accusative (in cl. also with dative; cf. M, _Pr._, 105f.),
with radical sense **round about** (as distinct from ἀμφί, _on both sides_).
I. C. genitive,
1. of place, **about** (poët.).
2. Causal, **about, on account of, concerning, in reference to**: [[Mat.2.8|Mat.2:8]], [[Mrk.1.44|Mrk.1:44]], [[Luk.4.38|Luk.4:38]], [[Jhn.16.26|Jhn.16:26]], [[Act.28.21|Act.28:21]], al. mult.; τὰ περί, with genitive, **the things concerning** one, **one's _state_ or _case_**: [[Mrk.5.27|Mrk.5:27]], [[Act.1.3; 28.15|Act.1:3 28:15]], [[Eph.6.22|Eph.6:22]], al.; at the beginning of a sentence, περί, **regarding, as to**, [[1Co.7.1|1Co.7:1]], al.; in the sense **on account of** ([[Mat.26.28|Mat.26:28]], [[1Co.1.13|1Co.1:13]], al.), often with ὑπέρ as variant (cf. M, _Pr._, 105).
II. C. accusative,
1. of place, **about, around**: [[Mat.3.4|Mat.3:4]], [[Mrk.1.6|Mrk.1:6]], [[Luk.13.8|Luk.13:8]], [[Act.22.6|Act.22:6]], al.; οἱ περί, with accusative of person(s), of one's associates, friends, etc., [[Mrk.4.10|Mrk.4:10]], [[Luk.22.49|Luk.22:49]], [[Jhn.11.19|Jhn.11:19]], [[Act.13.13|Act.13:13]]; οἱ περὶ τ. τοιαῦτα ἐργάται, [[Act.19.25|Act.19:25]] metaphorically, **about, as to, concerning**: [[1Ti.1.19; 6.4|1Ti.1:19 6:4]] [[2Ti.2.18; 3.8|2Ti.2:18 3:8]], [[Tit.2.7|Tit.2:7]]; τὰ περὶ ἐμέ, [[Php.2.23|Php.2:23]] αἱ περὶ τ. λοιπὰ ἐπιθυμίαι, [[Mrk.4.19|Mrk.4:19]]
2. Of time, in a loose reckoning, **about, near**: [[Mat.20.3, 5, 6, 9; 27.46|Mat.20:3, 5 6, 9 27:46]], [[Mrk.6.48|Mrk.6:48]], [[Act.10.3, 9; 22.6|Act.10:3, 9 22:6]].
III. **In composition**: **round about** (περιβάλλω, περίκειμαι), **beyond, over and above** (περιποιέω, περιλείπω), **to excess** (περιεργάζομαι, περισσεύω).
(AS)

G4098.def:
**πίπτω **
[in LXX chiefly for נָפַל ;]
**to fall**;
1. **of descent, to fall, fall down or from**: before ἐπί, with accusative loc., [[Mat.10.29|Mat.10:29]], al.; εἰς, [[Mat.15.14|Mat.15:14]], al.; ἐς μέσῳ, with genitive, [[Luk.8.7|Luk.8:7]] παρὰ τ. ὁδόν, [[Mat.13.4|Mat.13:4]], [[Mrk.4.4|Mrk.4:4]], [[Luk.8.5|Luk.8:5]]; before ἀπό, [[Mat.15.27|Mat.15:27]], al.; ἐκ, [[Mrk.13.25|Mrk.13:25]], [[Luk.10.18|Luk.10:18]], [[Rev.8.10; 9.1|Rev.8:10 9:1]]. Metaphorical: ὁ ἥλιος, before ἐπί, [[Rev.7.16|Rev.7:16]] ἀχλὺς κ. σκότος, [[Act.13.11|Act.13:11]] ὁ κλῆρος, [[Act.1.26|Act.1:26]] ὑπὸ κρίσιν, [[Jas.5.12|Jas.5:12]]
2. **Of prostration, **
(a) **of persons, to fall prostrate, prostrate oneself**: χαμαί [[Jhn.18.6|Jhn.18:6]] before ἐπί, with accusative, [[Mat.17.6|Mat.17:6]], [[Act.9.4|Act.9:4]]; id. with genitive, [[Mrk.9.20|Mrk.9:20]] πρὸς τ. πόδας, [[Act.5.10|Act.5:10]], [[Rev.1.17|Rev.1:17]]; πεσὼν ἐξέψυξε, [[Act.5.5|Act.5:5]] of supplication, **homage or worship**: πρὸς (παρὰ, ἐπὶ) τ. πὸδας, [[Mrk.5.22|Mrk.5:22]], [[Luk.8.41|Luk.8:41]], [[Act.10.25|Act.10:25]], al.; π. καὶ προσκυνεῖν, [[Rev.5.14; 19.4|Rev.5:14 19:4]]; ptcp. with προσκυνεῖν, [[Mat.2.11|Mat.2:11]], al.; ἐνώπιον, [[Rev.4.10; 5.8|Rev.4:10 5:8]]; ἐπὶ πρόσωπον, [[Mat.26.39|Mat.26:39]], al.;
(b) **of things, to fall, fall down**: [[Mat.21.44|Mat.21:44]], [[Luk.23.30|Luk.23:30]]; of falling to ruin and destruction, [[Mat.7.25|Mat.7:25]], [[Act.15.16|Act.15:16]], [[Heb.11.30|Heb.11:30]]; ἔπεσε (timeless aorist; M, _Pr._,134), [[Rev.18.2|Rev.18:2]] Metaphorical: [[Rom.11.11|Rom.11:11]] πόθεν πέπτωκας, [[Rev.2.5|Rev.2:5]] opposite to ἑστόναι, [[1Co.10.12|1Co.10:12]] to στήκειν, [[Rom.14.4|Rom.14:4]] of virtues, [[1Co.13.8|1Co.13:8]] of precepts, [[Luk.16.17|Luk.16:17]]
(cf. ἀνα-, ἀντι-, ἀπο-, ἐκ-, ἐπι-, κατα-, παρα-, περι-, προσ-, συν-πίπτω.)
συν-πίπτω (Rec. συμπ-),
[in LXX for נָפַל, etc. ;]
to fall together, fall in, etc.: of a house (cf. MM, xxiv), [[Luk.6.49|Luk.6:49]]†
(AS)

G4066.def:
**περί-χωρος**, -ον
[in LXX: chiefly (ἡ π.) for כִּכָּר ;]
round about, neighbouring (Dem., Plut., al.). In LXX and NT, as subst., ἡ π. (sc. γῆ), **the region round about**: [[Mat.14.35|Mat.14:35]], [[Mrk.1.28|Mrk.1:28]], [[Luk.4.14, 37; 7.17; 8.37|Luk.4:14, 37 7:17 8:37]], [[Act.14.6|Act.14:6]]; ἡ π. τοῦ Ἰορδάνου, [[Luk.3.3|Luk.3:3]] by meton. for the people of the same region, [[Mat.3.5|Mat.3:5]]†
(AS)

G4008.def:
**πέραν **
_adv._, [in LXX for עֵבֶר and cognate forms ;]
**on the other side, across **(usually with the idea of water lying between);
(a) as in the older poets, as prep. with genitive: τ. θαλάσσης, [[Jhn.6.1, 17; 6.22, 25|Jhn.6:1, 17 6:22, 25]]; τ. Ἰορδάνου, [[Mat.4.15|Mat.4:15]] (LXX), [[Mat.4.25; 19.1|Mat.4:25 19:1]], [[Mrk.3.8; 10.1|Mrk.3:8 10:1]], [[Jhn.1.28; 3.26; 10.40|Jhn.1:28 3:26 10:40]]; τ. χειμάρρου τ. Κέδρων, [[Jhn.18.1|Jhn.18:1]]
(b) τὸ π., **the region beyond, the other side**: [[Mat.8.18, 28; 14.22; 16.5|Mat.8:18, 28 14:22 16:5]], [[Mrk.4.35; 5.21; 6.45; 8.13|Mrk.4:35 5:21 6:45 8:13]]; τ. θαλάσσης, [[Mrk.5.1|Mrk.5:1]] τ. λίμνης, [[Luk.8.22|Luk.8:22]]†
(AS)

G4074.def:
**Πέτρος**, -ου, ὁ (i.e. **a stone**, see: πέτρα, Κηφᾶς),
**Simon Peter**, **the Apostle**: [[Mat.4.18; 10.2|Mat.4:18 10:2]], [[Mrk.3.16|Mrk.3:16]], [[Luk.5.8|Luk.5:8]], [[Jhn.1.41, 43|Jhn.1:41, 43]], al.
(AS)

G4013.def:
**περι-άγω **
[in LXX: [[Amo.2.10|Amo.2:10]] (הָלַךְ hi.); [[Isa.28.27|Isa.28:27]], [[Ezk.47.2|Eze.47:2]] (סָבַב hi., ho.); [[Ezk.37.2; 46.21|Eze.37:2 46:21]] (עָבַר hi), [[2Ma.4.38|2Ma.4:38]] [[2Mac.6.10|2Mac 6:10]] * ;]
1. **to lead about or around**: with accusative of person(s), [[1Co.9.5|1Co.9:5]]
2. Intrans., **to go about**: [[Act.13.11|Act.13:11]] before ἐν, [[Mat.4.23|Mat.4:23]] with accusative loc. (governed by the περι-, not so in cl., see Bl., § 34, 1; 53, 1), [[Mat.9.35; 23.15|Mat.9:35 23:15]], [[Mrk.6.6|Mrk.6:6]].†
(AS)

G4052.def:
**περισσεύω**
(περισσός), [in LXX: [[1Sa.2.33|1Ki.2:33]] (מַרְבִּית), [[1Ki.2.36|1Ki.2:36]] [[Ecc.3.19|Ecc.3:19]] (יָתַר ni., יוׄתֵר), [[Tob.4.16|Tob.4:16]], [[Sir.10.27; 11.12; 19.24|Sir.10:27 11:12 19:24]], [[Sir.30.38|Sir 30:38]] ([[Sir.33.29|Sir.33:29]]), [[1Ma.3.30|1Ma.3:30]] * ;]
I. Prop., intrans.,
1. of things, to be over and above the number (Hes.), hence,
(a) **to be or remain over**: [[Mat.14.20; 15.37|Mat.14:20 15:37]], [[Luk.9.17|Luk.9:17]], [[Jhn.6.12-13|Jhn.6:12-13]];
(b) **to abound, be in abundance**: [[Mrk.12.44|Mrk.12:44]], [[Luk.12.15; 21.4|Luk.12:15 21:4]], [[Act.16.5|Act.16:5]], [[Rom.3.7; 5.15|Rom.3:7 5:15]], [[2Co.1.5; 8.2; 9.12|2Co.1:5 8:2 9:12]], [[Php.1.26|Php.1:26]].
2. **Of persons, **
(a) **to abound in, have in abundance**: [[1Co.14.12; 15.58|1Co.14:12 15:58]], [[Php.4.12, 18|Php.4:12, 18]]; with genitive, [[Luk.15.17|Luk.15:17]] T;
(b) **to be superior or better, to excel**: absol., [[1Co.3.9; 8.8|1Co.3:9 8:8]]; with dative ref., [[2Co.3.9|2Co.3:9]] before ἐν, [[Rom.15.13|Rom.15:13]], [[1Co.15.58|1Co.15:58]], [[2Co.3.9; 8.7|2Co.3:9 8:7]], [[Col.2.7|Col.2:7]]; μᾶλλον, [[1Th.4.1; 4.10|1Th.4:1 4:10]]; μ καὶ μ., [[Php.1.9|Php.1:9]] πλεῖον, [[Mat.5.20|Mat.5:20]]
II. In late writers (Lft., _Notes_, 48 f.), trans.,
(a) **to make to abound**: with accusative before εἰς, [[2Co.4.15; 9.8|2Co.4:15 9:8]], [[Eph.1.8|Eph.1:8]]; pass., [[Mat.13.12; 25.29|Mat.13:12 25:29]]; with genitive of thing(s), [[Luk.15.17|Luk.15:17]], WH;
(b) **to make to excel**: with accusative of person(s), dative of thing(s), [[1Th.3.12|1Th.3:12]] (cf. ὑπερ-περισσεύω).†
_SYN._: πλεονάζω (AS)

G4053.def:
**περισσός**, -ή, -όν
[in LXX for יֶתֶר and cogn. forms ;]
1. **more than sufficient, over and above, abundant**: [[Jhn.10.10|Jhn.10:10]], [[2Co.9.1|2Co.9:1]]; with genitive (a popular substitute for πλειών, Bl., § 11, 3.4), [[Mat.5.37|Mat.5:37]] id. with ellips. genitive, [[Mat.5.47|Mat.5:47]] (EV, more than others; but see infr.); εκ περισσοῦ, [[Mrk.6.51|Mrk.6:51]], Rec., T. (on ὑπὲρ ὲκ π., see: ὑπερεκπερισσοῦ). Compar. neut., -ότερον: [[Luk.12.4, 48|Luk.12:4, 48]]; with genitive, [[Mrk.12.33|Mrk.12:33]] adverbially (cf. περισσῶς), more abund­antly, [[2Co.10.8|2Co.10:8]], [[Heb.6.17; 7.15|Heb.6:17 7:15]]; with genitive, π. πάντων, [[1Co.15.10|1Co.15:10]] pleonast., μᾶλλον π., [[Mrk.7.36|Mrk.7:36]]
2. **out of the common, pre-eminent, superior**: [[Mat.5.47|Mat.5:47]] (Thayer, see word, but see supr.); τὸ π., as subst., [[Rom.3.1|Rom.3:1]] compar., -ότερος, with genitive, [[Mat.11.9|Mat.11:9]], [[Luk.7.26|Luk.7:26]]; with subst., [[Mrk.12.40|Mrk.12:40]], [[Luk.20.47|Luk.20:47]], [[1Co.12.23-24|1Co.12:23-24]], [[2Co.2.7|2Co.2:7]].†
(AS)

G4095.def:
**πίνω **
[in LXX chiefly for שָׁתָה ;]
**to drink**: absol., [[Luk.2.19|Luk.2:19]], [[Jhn.4.7|Jhn.4:7]], al.; with accusative of thing(s), [[Mat.6.26, 31|Mat.6:26, 31]] [[Mrk.14.25|Mrk.14:25]], al.; of habitual use, [[Luk.1.15|Luk.1:15]], [[Rom.14.21|Rom.14:21]], al.; by meton., τὸ ποτήριον, [[1Co.10.21|1Co.10:21]], al.; of the earth absorbing rain (Hdt., al.), [[Heb.6.7|Heb.6:7]] spiritually, of the blood of Christ, [[Jhn.6.53-54, 56|Jhn.6:53-54, 56]]; before ἐκ (of the vessel), [[Mat.26.27|Mat.26:27]], al.; id. (of the drink; Bl., § 36, 1), [[Mat.26.29|Mat.26:29]], [[Jhn.4.13-14|Jhn.4:13-14]] [[Rev.14.10|Rev.14:10]], al.; ἀπό, [[Luk.22.18|Luk.22:18]] (cf. ἀπο-, συν-πίνω; on the form πίεσαι, [[Luk.17.8|Luk.17:8]], see Bl., § 21, 8, and on the contr. aor. πεῖν, M, _Pr._, 44 f., Thackeray, _Gr._, 63 f.)
(AS)

G4071.def:
**πετεινός**, -ή, -όν
(πέτομαι), [in LXX chiefly for עוֹף ;]
in trag., Ion. and late writers, winged, flying; as subst., τὸ π., **a winged fowl, a bird**: pl., [[Mat.6.26; 8.20; 13.4, 32|Mat.6:26 8:20 13:4, 32]], [[Mrk.4.4, 32|Mrk.4:4, 32]], [[Luk.8.5; 9.58; 12.24; 13.19|Luk.8:5 9:58 12:24 13:19]], [[Act.10.12; 11.6|Act.10:12 11:6]], [[Rom.1.23|Rom.1:23]], [[Jas.3.7|Jas.3:7]].†
(AS)

G4083.def:
**πῆχυς**, -εως genitive pl., -ῶν (for Att.. -εων, see WH, _App._, 157; Thackeray, _Gr._, 151; Deiss., BS, 153),
[in LXX chiefly and frequently for אַמָּה ;]
1. the forearm (Hom.).
2. **As a measure of length, a cubit**: [[Mat.6.27|Mat.6:27]], [[Luk.12.25|Luk.12:25]], [[Jhn.21.8|Jhn.21:8]], [[Rev.21.17|Rev.21:17]].†
(AS)

G4073.def:
**πέτρα**, -ας, ἡ
[in LXX chiefly for סֶלַע, צוּר ;]
a rock, i.e. a mass of live rock as distinct from πέτρος, **a detached stone or boulder **: [[Mat.7.24-25; 27.51, 60|Mat.7:24-25 27:51, 60]] [[Mrk.15.46|Mrk.15:46]], [[Luk.6.48; 8.6, 13|Luk.6:48 8:6, 13]]; of a hollow rock, a cave, [[Rev.6.15-16|Rev.6:15-16]] (of. [[Isa.2.10|Isa.2:10]], al.). Metaphorical, [[Mat.16.18|Mat.16:18]] (on the meaning, see Hort, Eccl., 16 ff., but cf. also _ICC_, in l), [[1Co.10.4|1Co.10:4]] = πέτρος, [[Rom.9.33|Rom.9:33]], [[1Pe.2.8|1Pe.2:8]]" (LXX) .†
(AS)

G4082.def:
**πἡρα**, -ας, ἡ
[in LXX: [[Jdt.10.5; 13.10, 15|Jdth.10:5 13:10, 15]] * ;]
a leathern pouch for victuals, etc., **a wallet **(Deiss. thinks an alms-bag, see _LAE_, 108 ff.): [[Mat.10.10|Mat.10:10]], [[Mrk.6.8|Mrk.6:8]], [[Luk.9.3; 10.4; 22.35-36|Luk.9:3 10:4 22:35-36]].†
(AS)

G4051.def:
**περίσσευμα**, -τος, τό
(περισσεύω) [in LXX: [[Ecc.2.15|Ecc.2:15]] * ;]
**that which is over and above, superfluity, abundance**: opposite to ὑστέρημα (which see), [[2Co.8.13-14;|2Co.8:13-14]] pl., [[Mrk.8.8|Mrk.8:8]] metaphorically, π. τ. καρδίας, [[Mat.12.34|Mat.12:34]], [[Luk.6.45|Luk.6:45]] (cf. Ec, l.with; Plut., al.).†
(AS)

G4075.def:
**πετρώδης**, -ες
(πέτρα, εἶδος),
**rock-like, rocky, stony**: τὸ, τὰ π., of shallow soil with underlying rock, [[Mat.13.5, 20|Mat.13:5, 20]], [[Mrk.4.5, 16|Mrk.4:5, 16]].†
(AS)

G4097.def:
**πιπράσκω **
[in LXX chiefly for מָכַר ni. ;]
**to sell**: with accusative of thing(s), [[Mat.13.46|Mat.13:46]] (on this pf., see Bl., § 59, 5), [[Act.2.45; 4.34; 5.4|Act.2:45 4:34 5:4]]; with genitive (of price), [[Mat.26.9|Mat.26:9]], [[Mrk.14.5|Mrk.14:5]], [[Jhn.12.5|Jhn.12:5]]; with accusative of person(s) (of slavery), [[Mat.18.25|Mat.18:25]] hence metaphorically, [[Rom.7.14|Rom.7:14]] (cf. [[4Ki.17.17|4Ki.17:17]], [[1Ma.1.15|1Ma.1:15]], al.).†
(AS)

G4060.def:
**περι-τίθημι **
[in LXX for נָתַן, שׂוּם, etc. ;]
**to place or put around**: with accusative and dative, [[Mat.21.33; 27.48|Mat.21:33 27:48]], [[Mrk.12.1; 15.36|Mrk.12:1 15:36]], [[Jhn.19.29|Jhn.19:29]]; of garments, etc., **to put on**: [[Mat.27.28|Mat.27:28]] [[Mrk.15.17|Mrk.15:17]] ([[Sir.6.31|Sir.6:31]]). Metaphorical, like περιβάλλω, to bestow, confer (Thuc., al., [[Est.1.20|Est.1:20]]): [[1Co.12.23|1Co.12:23]].†
(AS)

G4090.def:
**πικρῶς **
_adv._ (πικρός), [in LXX for מַר, מָרַר pi. ;]
**bitterly**: metaphorically, (cf. πικρὸν δάκρυον, Hom.), ἔκλαυσε π., [[Mat.26.75|Mat.26:75]], [[Luk.22.62|Luk.22:62]] (see MM, xviii, see word παρακολουθέω).†
(AS)

G4091.def:
**Πειλᾶτος** (Rec. Πιλάτος, Tr., -ᾶτος, see WH, _App._, 155), -ου, ὁ,
**Pontius Pilate**: [[Mat.27.2|Mat.27:2]], [[Mrk.15.1|Mrk.15:1]], [[Luk.3.1|Luk.3:1]], [[Jhn.18.29|Jhn.18:29]], [[Act.3.13|Act.3:13]], [[1Ti.6.13|1Ti.6:13]], al
(AS)

G4017.def:
**περι-βλέπω **
[in LXX for שׁוּר, etc. ;]
to look around (at). Mid., to look about one (at) : absol., [[Mrk.9.8; 10.23|Mrk.9:8 10:23]]; with inf., [[Mrk.5.32|Mrk.5:32]] with accusative of person(s), [[Mrk.3.5, 34|Mrk.3:5, 34]], [[Luk.6.10|Luk.6:10]]; πάντα, [[Mrk.11.11|Mrk.11:11]]†
(AS)

G4077.def:
**πηγή**, -ῆς, ἡ
[in LXX chiefly for עַיִן, also for מָקוֹר, etc. ;]
**a spring, fountain **: [[Jas.3.11|Jas.3:11]], [[2Pe.2.17|2Pe.2:17]]; τ. δάτων, [[Rev.8.10; 14.7; 16.4|Rev.8:10 14:7 16:4]]; of a well fed by a spring, [[Jhn.4.6|Jhn.4:6]] π. τοῦ αἵματος, of a flow of blood, [[Mrk.5.29|Mrk.5:29]] metaphorically, [[Jhn.4.14|Jhn.4:14]], [[Rev.7.17; 21.6|Rev.7:17 21:6]].†
(AS)

G4063.def:
**περι-τρέχω **
[in LXX: [[Amo.8.12|Amo.8:12]], [[Jer.5.1|Jer.5:1]] (שׁוּט pi.) * ;]
**to run about**: with accusative loc., [[Mrk.6.55|Mrk.6:55]]†
(AS)

G4064.def:
**περι-φέρω **
[in LXX: [[Ecc.7.8|Ecc.7:8]] (7) (הָלַל po.), al. ;]
**to carry about**: [[Mrk.6.55|Mrk.6:55]], [[2Co.4.10|2Co.4:10]]. Pass., metaphorically: [[Eph.4.14|Eph.4:14]]†
(AS)

G4029.def:
**περί-κειμαι **
[in LXX: Ep. Je 24, 58, [[4Ma.12.3|4Ma.12:3]] * ;]
1. **to lie round about**: μύλος, λίθος (RV, were hanged about), [[Mrk.9.42|Mrk.9:42]], [[Luk.17.2|Luk.17:2]]; νεφος μαρτύρων, [[Heb.12.1|Heb.12:1]]
2. **to have around one, be clothed with**: [[Act.28.20|Act.28:20]] figuratively, ἀσθένειαν, [[Heb.5.2|Heb.5:2]]†
(AS)

G4055.def: more superabundant rabundant, excess, far fetched, superfluous (in number, degree or character)

G4028.def:
**περι-καλύπτω **
[in LXX for כָּסָה pi., שָׁבַץ pu., etc. ;]
to cover around, cover up or over. with accusative, [[Mrk.14.65|Mrk.14:65]], [[Luk.22.64|Luk.22:64]]; pass., before χρυσίῳ, [[Heb.9.4|Heb.9:4]]†
(AS)

G4032.def:
**περι-κρύπτω **
**to conceal entirely, keep hidden**: late 2 aor., περιέκρυβσν (but see BL, § 17; Soph., _Lex._, see word περικρύβω), [[Luk.1.24|Luk.1:24]]†
(AS)

G4040.def:
**περί-οικος**, -ον
[in LXX for כִּכָּר, etc. ;]
**dwelling around**; as subst., ὁ π., **a neighbour**: [[Luk.1.58|Luk.1:58]] (cf. πλησίον).†
(AS)

G4059.def:
**περι-τέμνω **
[in LXX chiefly for מוּל ;] (Ion., Epic. and late writers),
to cut around (Hdt.), hence, to circumcise (π. τὰ αἰδοῖα, Hdt.) : [[Luk.1.59; 2.21|Luk.1:59 2:21]], [[Jhn.7.22|Jhn.7:22]], [[Act.7.8; 15.5; 16.3; 21.21|Act.7:8 15:5 16:3 21:21]]. Pass. and mid., **to be circumcised, receive circumcision**: [[Act.15.1|Act.15:1]], [[1Co.7.18|1Co.7:18]], [[Gal.2.3; 5.2-3; 6.12-13|Gal.2:3 5:2-3 6:12-13]] Metaphorical (cf. [[Deu.10.16|Deu.10:16]], [[Jer.4.4|Jer.4:4]], al.), [[Col.2.11|Col.2:11]] (see Deiss., BS, 151 f.; MM, xix).†
(AS)

G4093.def:
**πινακίδιον**, -ου, τό
(dimin. of πινακίς, which see), [in Sm.: [[Ezk.9.2|Eze.9:2]] * ;]
**a writing tablet**: [[Luk.1.63|Luk.1:63]]†
(AS)

G4023.def:
**περι-έχω**,
[in LXX for H661, H5362 hi., H6822 pi., etc. ;]
1. **to surround, encompass**: [[Luk.5.9|Luk.5:9]] (cf. MM, xix).
2. to comprehend, include, contain, esp. of books: with accusative, [[Act.23.25|Act.23:25]], Rec.; accusative to a late usage, intrans. (BL, § 53, 1.3; MM, xix; Hort, in l), it stands written, [[1Pe.2.6|1Pe.2:6]]†
(AS)

G4085.def:
**πιέζω **
[in LXX : [[Mic.6.15|Mic.6:15]] (דָּרַךְ)* ;]
1. **to press, press down or to­gether**: [[Luk.6.38|Luk.6:38]] (cl).
2. Later, to seize (see: πιάζω).†
(AS)

G4045.def:
**περι-πίπτω **
[in LXX: [[Rut.2.3|Rut.2:3]], [[2Sa.1.6|2Ki.1:6]] (קָרָה), [[Pro.11.5|Pro.11:5]] (נָפַל), Dan LXX 2:9, [[2Ma.6.13|2Ma.6:13]] [[2Mac.9.7|2Mac 9:7]] [[2Mac.9.21|2Mac 9:21]] [[2Mac.10.4|2Mac 10:4]] * ;]
1. to fall around.
2. **to fall in with, light upon, come across**: with dative, λῃσταῖς, [[Luk.10.30|Luk.10:30]] πειρασμοῖς, [[Jas.1.2|Jas.1:2]] before εἰς, [[Act.27.41|Act.27:41]]†
(AS)

G4049.def:
**περι-σπάω**, -ῶ
[in LXX chiefly for עָנָה ;]
to draw around, draw off or away. Metaphorical, **to distract**: pass., [[Luk.10.40|Luk.10:40]]†
(AS)

G4076.def:
**πήγανον**, -ου, τό
περισσότερον, -ως, see: περισσῶς
**περισσῶς**
_ adv._ (περισσός) [in LXX: [[Psa.31.23|Psa.31:23]] (יֶתֶר -עַל), Da TH [[Dan.7.7, 19; 8.9|Dan.7:7, 19 8:9]] (יַתִּיר, יֶתֶר) [[2Ma.8.27|2Ma.8:27]] [[2Mac.12.44|2Mac 12:44]] A * ;]
**beyond measure, exceedingly, abundantly**: [[Mat.27.23|Mat.27:23]], [[Mrk.10.26; 15.14|Mrk.10:26 15:14]], [[Act.26.11|Act.26:11]]. Compar.
(a) περισσότερον (see: περισσός);
(b) **περισσοτέρως**: [[2Co.1.12; 2.4; 7.15; 11.23|2Co.1:12 2:4 7:15 11:23]], [[Gal.1.14|Gal.1:14]], [[Php.1.14|Php.1:14]], [[1Th.2.17|1Th.2:17]], [[Heb.2.1; 13.19|Heb.2:1 13:19]]; π. μᾶλλον, [[2Co.7.13|2Co.7:13]] opposite to ἧττον, [[2Co.12.15|2Co.12:15]]†
(AS)

G4024.def:
**περι-ζώννυμι and -ύω**
(see Veitch, see word), [in LXX chiefly for חָגַר, also for אָזַר, etc. ;]
to gird (with dupl, accusative, as ὁ περιζωννύων με δύναμιν, [[Psa.18.32|Psa.18:32]]): pass., αἱ ὀσφύες περιεζωσμέναι, [[Luk.12.35|Luk.12:35]] π. ζώνην χρυσῆν, [[Rev.1.13; 15.6|Rev.1:13 15:6]] (but see infr.). Mid., **to gird oneself**: [[Luk.12.37; 17.8|Luk.12:37 17:8]] (and so perh. Re, ll. with supr., cf. [[1Sa.2.4|1Ki.2:4]]); with accusative of thing(s) (figuratively), τ. ὀσφύν, [[Eph.6.14|Eph.6:14]] (before ἐν, cf. [[1Ch.15.27|1Ch.15:27]]).†
(AS)

G4046.def:
**περι-ποιέω**, -ῶ
[in LXX for pi., hi., etc. ;]
to make to remain over, preserve.
Mid.
(a) **to keep or save for oneself**: τ. ψυχήν (cf. Xen., Cyr., iv, 4, 10; Arist., Pol., v, 11, 30), [[Luk.17.33|Luk.17:33]]
(b) to get or gain for oneself, get possession of (Thuc., Xen., al.) : [[Act.20.28|Act.20:28]], [[1Ti.3.13|1Ti.3:13]].†
(AS)

G4033.def:
**περι-κυκλόω**, -ῶ
[in LXX chiefly for סָבַב ;]
**to encircle, encompass**: of a besieged city, [[Luk.19.43|Luk.19:43]]†
(AS)

G4061.def:
**περι-τομή**, -ῆς, ἡ
(περιτέμνω), [in LXX: [[Gen.17.13|Gen.17:13]], [[Exo.4.25-26|Exo.4:25-26]] (מוּל ni., מוּלָה), [[Jer.11.16|Jer.11:16]] * ;]
**circumcision**;
(a) **of the rite itself **: [[Jhn.7.22-23|Jhn.7:22-23]] [[Act.7.8|Act.7:8]], [[Rom.4.11|Rom.4:11]], [[Gal.5.11|Gal.5:11]], [[Php.3.5|Php.3:5]];
(b) **of the state of circumcision**: [[Rom.2.25-28; 3.1|Rom.2:25-28 3:1]], [[1Co.7.19|1Co.7:19]], [[Gal.5.6; 6.15|Gal.5:6 6:15]], [[Col.3.11|Col.3:11]]; ἐν π. ὤν, [[Rom.4.10|Rom.4:10]]
(with) by meton., π. = οἱ περιτμηθέντες, **the circumcised**: [[Rom.3.30; 4.9, 12; 15.8|Rom.3:30 4:9, 12 15:8]], [[Gal.2.7-9|Gal.2:7-9]], [[Eph.2.11|Eph.2:11]]; οἱ ἐκ τῆς π., of Jews, [[Rom.4.12|Rom.4:12]] of Jewish Christians, [[Act.11.2|Act.11:2]], [[Gal.2.12|Gal.2:12]], [[Tit.1.10|Tit.1:10]]; οἱ ἐκ π. πιστοί, [[Act.10.45|Act.10:45]] οἱ ὄντες ἐκ π., [[Col.4.11|Col.4:11]] Metaphorical, [[Rom.2.29|Rom.2:29]], [[Col.2.11|Col.2:11]], [[Php.3.3|Php.3:3]].†
(AS)

G4084.def:
**πιάζω**
(cf. M_Gr._ πιάνω; see Kennedy, _Sources_, 155), Doric and late Att.. for πιέζω in its later senses [in LXX: [[Sng.2.15|Sng.2:15]] (אָחַז), [[Sir.23.21|Sir.23:21]] * ;]
1. **to lay hold of**: [[Act.3.7|Act.3:7]] (Theocr.).
2. **to take, capture, apprehend**: [[Jhn.7.30, 32; 7.44; 8.20; 10.39; 11.57; 21.3, 10|Jhn.7:30, 32 7:44 8:20 10:39 11:57 21:3, 10]] [[Act.12.4|Act.12:4]], [[2Co.11.32|2Co.11:32]], [[Rev.19.20|Rev.19:20]] (see MM, xx).†
(AS)

G4081.def:
**πηλός**, οῦ, ἁ
[in LXX chiefly for חֹמֶר, טִיט ]
1. **clay, as used by a potter**: [[Rom.9.21|Rom.9:21]] (cf. [[Isa.29.16|Isa.29:16]], al.).
2. **- βόρβορος, wet clay, mud**: [[Jhn.9.6, 11; 9.14-15|Jhn.9:6, 11 9:14-15]] †
(AS)

G4026.def:
**περι-ίστημι (Rec. ΐστημι) **
[in LXX: [[Jos.6.3|Jos.6:3]] (סָבַב), [[2Sa.13.31|2Ki.13:31]] (נָצַב ni.), [[1Sa.4.16|1Ki.4:16]], Ep. [[Jer.37.1-21|Jer.37:1-21]], [[Jdt.5.22|Jdth.5:22]], [[2Ma.14.9|2Ma.14:9]] * ;]
1. to place around.
2. **to stand around**: [[Jhn.11.42|Jhn.11:42]] with accusative of person(s), [[Act.25.7|Act.25:7]] Mid. (in late writers), **to turn oneself about to avoid, to shun**: with accusative of thing(s), [[2Ti.2.16|2Ti.2:16]], [[Tit.3.9|Tit.3:9]].†
(AS)

G4019.def:
**περι-δέω **
[in LXX: [[Job.12.18|Job.12:18]] (אָסַר)* ;]
**to tie round, bind round**: with accusative and dative, pass., [[Jhn.11.44|Jhn.11:44]]†
(AS)

G4037.def:
**περι-μένω **
[in LXX: [[Gen.49.18|Gen.49:18]] (קָוָה pi.), [[Wis.8.12|Wis.8:12]] * ;]
**to wait for**: with acce., [[Act.1.4|Act.1:4]]†
(AS)

G4042.def:
**περι-οχή**, -ῆς, ἡ
(περιέχω), [in LXX for מָצוּד, מָצוֹר, etc. ;]
1. compass, circumference.
2. **a portion circumscribed, a section**: [[Act.8.32|Act.8:32]]†
(AS)

G4015.def:
**περι-αστράπτω **
[in LXX: [[4Ma.4.10|4Ma.4:10]] * ;]
**to flash around**: with accusative, [[Act.9.3|Act.9:3]] before περί [[Act.22.6|Act.22:6]] (Eccl, and Byzant.).†
(AS)

G4099.def:
**Πισιδία**, -ας, ι
**Pisidia, a region of Asia Minor**: [[Act.14.24|Act.14:24]]
(AS)

G4048.def:
**περι-ρήγνυμι**
(Rec. -ρρ-, see supr.) [in LXX: [[2Ma.4.38|2Ma.4:38]] * ;]
**to break or tear off all around**: frequently of garments, τ. ἰμάτια, [[Act.16.22|Act.16:22]]†
(AS)

G4022.def:
**περι-έρχομαι **
[in LXX chiefly for סָבַב ;]
**to go about **(as an itinerant): [[Act.19.13; 28.13|Act.19:13 28:13]] (περιελόντες, WH, R, mg.), [[Heb.11.37|Heb.11:37]] τ. οἰκίας, **from house to house**: [[1Ti.5.13|1Ti.5:13]]†
(AS)

G4021.def:
**περίεργος**, -ον
I. **of persons**;
1. over careful.
2. **curious, meddling, a busybody**: [[1Ti.5.13|1Ti.5:13]]
II. **Of things**;
1. over-wrought.
2. super­fluous.
3. **curious, uncanny**; τὰ π., **curious arts, magic**: [[Act.19.19|Act.19:19]] (see Deiss., BS, 3235.).†
(AS)

G4062.def:
**περι-τρέπω **
[in LXX: [[Wis.5.23|Wis.5:23]] * ;]
**to turn about, turn**: with accusative and, dative, [[Act.26.24|Act.26:24]] (cf. FlJ, _Ant._, ix, 4, 4).†
(AS)

G4031.def:
**περι-κρατής**, -ές
[in LXX: Da TH [[Sus.1.39|Sus 1:39]] A * ;]
**having full command of**: [[Act.27.16|Act.27:16]]†
(AS)

G4014.def:
**περι-αιρέω**, -ῶ
[in LXX chiefly for סוּר hi. ;]
to take away that which surrounds, take away, take off (τείχη, Hdt., Thuc.; χιτῶνα, Plat.; δακτύλιον, [[Gen.41.42|Gen.41:42]], cf. σφρηγῖδα, Hdt., ii, 151) : τ. κάλυΜΜα, pass., [[2Co.3.16|2Co.3:16]] as nautical term (RV, cast off), ἀγκύρας, [[Act.27.40|Act.27:40]] absol., **to cast loose**: [[Act.28.13|Act.28:13]] Metaphorical, **to take away entirely**: ἐλπίς, pass., [[Act.27.20|Act.27:20]] ἁμαρτίας, [[Heb.10.11|Heb.10:11]]†
(AS)

G4079.def:
**πηδάλιον**, -συ, τό
(πηδός, the blade of an oar),
**a rudder**: [[Jas.3.4|Jas.3:4]] pl., [[Act.27.40|Act.27:40]]†
(AS)

G4092.def:
**πίμπρημι**
(in cl. prose, rare in the simple form), [in LXX: [[Num.5.21-22, 27|Num.5:21-22, 27]] (צָבֶה) * ;]
1. to blow, burn.
2. Later, **to cause to swell**; mid., of parts of the body, to become swollen (LXX) : [[Act.28.6|Act.28:6]] (cf. ἐμπίπρημι).†
(AS)

G4050.def:
**περισσεία**, -ας, ἡ
(περισσευω), [in LXX: [[Ecc.12.1-14|Ecc.12:1-14]] (יִתְרוֹן and cogn. forms, [[Ecc.1.3|Ecc.1:3]], al.) * ;]
1. **abundance, superfluity**: [[Rom.5.17|Rom.5:17]], [[2Co.8.2; 10.15|2Co.8:2 10:15]], [[Jas.1.21|Jas.1:21]] (so also Inscr., see _LAE_, 80).
2. (a) superiority (Ec, see supr.);
(b) profit (ib.).†
(AS)

G4096.def:
**πιότης**, -ητος, ἡ
(πίων, fat), [in LXX chiefly for דֶּשֶׁן ;]
**fatness**: [[Rom.11.17|Rom.11:17]]†
(AS)

G4069.def:
1. **Persian **, (Aeschulus Tragicus), etc.
2. as _Substantive_, (.] (entry γῆ); **Persis, Persia **, now **Farsistan **, (Herdotus Historicus)
3. (entry γυνή); **a Persian woman **, (Xenophon Historicus)
4. (entry χλαῖνα); **a Persian cloak **, (Aristophanes Comicus)
(ML)

G4027.def:
**περι-κάθαρμα**, -τος, τό
(περικαθαίρω, to purify on all sides or completely, [[Deu.18.10|Deu.18:10]], [[Jos.5.4|Jos.5:4]], [[4Ma.1.29|4Ma.1:29]]*), [in LXX: [[Pro.21.18|Pro.21:18]] (כֹּפֶר)* ;]
1. a victim, expiation (Pr, l.with).
2. **refuse, rubbish**: pl., [[1Co.4.13|1Co.4:13]] (see _ICC_, in l).†
(AS)

G4067.def:
**περί-ψημα**, -τος, τό
(περιψράω, to wipe off all round), [in LXX: [[Tob.5.18|Tob.5:18]] * ;]
**that which is wiped off, offscouring**: metaphorically (assoc. with περικάθαρμα, which see), [[1Co.4.13|1Co.4:13]] (and so prob., To, l.with, as EV; but see Thayer, see word, for the meaning expiation, ransom, in To; and cf. LS, see word κάθαρμα; Lft., _Notes_, 200 f., and on Ign., _Eph._, 8).†
(AS)

G4018.def:
**περι-βόλαιον**, -ου, τό
(περιβάλλω), [in LXX chiefly for כְּסוּת, לְבוּשׁ and cognate forms ;]
that which is thrown around, a covering, in NT,
(a) a mantle ([[Psa.102.27|Psa.102:27]], [[Isa.59.17|Isa.59:17]], al.) : [[Heb.1.12|Heb.1:12]]" (LXX)
(b) **a veil**: [[1Co.11.15|1Co.11:15]] (but see _ICC_, in l).†
(AS)

G4068.def:
**περπερεύοραι**
(περπερος, vainglorious)
**to boast or vaunt oneself**: [[1Co.13.4|1Co.13:4]] (elsewhere. only in Antonin.; see Abbott, _Essays_, 87).†
(AS)

G4056.def: to a greater degree; especially, frequently, extremely **more, more abundantly, more earnestly, more vehemently,** [[2Co.7.13|2Cor. 7:13]] **exceedingly, extremely** [[Gal.1.14|Gal. 1:14]]

G4006.def:
**πεποίθησις**, -εως, ἡ
(πείθω), [in LXX: [[2Ki.18.19|4Ki.18:19]] (בִּטָּחוֹן)* ;]
**confidence**: [[2Co.1.15; 3.4; 10.2|2Co.1:15 3:4 10:2]], [[Eph.3.12|Eph.3:12]]; before εἰς, [[2Co.8.22|2Co.8:22]] ἐν, [[Php.3.4|Php.3:4]] (the word is condemned by the Atticists, see Rutherford, _NPhr._, 355).†
(AS)

G4070.def:
**πέρυσι **
_adv._ (πέρας),
**last year, a year ago**: ἀπὸ π. (as in π. see Deiss., BS, 221; _LAE_, 70), [[2Co.8.10; 9.2|2Co.8:10 9:2]].†
(AS)

G4080.def:
**πηλίκος**, -η, -ον
[in LXX: [[Zec.2.2|Zec.2:2]] (6) (כָּמַהּ), [[4Ma.15.22|4Ma.15:22]] * ;]
interrog., **how large, how great ? **(prop., of magnitude, as πόσος of quantity): in exclamations, = ἡλίκος (see Bl., § 51, 4), [[Gal.6.11|Gal.6:11]] of personal greatness, [[Heb.7.4|Heb.7:4]]†
(AS)

G4047.def:
**περι-ποίησις**, -εως, ἡ
(περιποιέω), [in LXX: [[2Ch.4.13|2Ch.4:13]] (12) (מִחְיָה) [[Mal.3.17|Mal.3:17]] (סְגֻלָּה), [[Hag.2.10|Hag.2:10]] (9) * ;]
1. **preservation**: [[Heb.10.39|Heb.10:39]] (2 Ch, l.with).
2. **acquisition, obtaining**: [[1Th.5.9|1Th.5:9]], [[2Th.2.14|2Th.2:14]] (and so perh. [[Eph.1.14|Eph.1:14]], see infr.).
3. **a possession**: [[Eph.1.14|Eph.1:14]] (but see supr., and cf. _ICC_, in l), [[1Pe.2.9|1Pe.2:9]] (LXX).†
(AS)

G4030.def:
**περι-κεφαλαία**, -ας, ἡ
[in LXX for כּוֹבַע, קוֹבַע ;]
**a helmet**: figuratively, [[1Th.5.8|1Th.5:8]] with genitive explic., π. τ. σωτηρίου, [[Eph.6.17|Eph.6:17]] (cf. [[Isa.59.17|Isa.59:17]]).†
(AS)

G4086.def:
**πιθανολογία**, -ας, ἡ
(πιθανός, persuasive, plausible),
in cl. (Plat),
the use of probable arguments, as opposite to demonstration (ἀπόδειξις); hence, **persuasive speech**: [[Col.2.4|Col.2:4]] (see _ICC_, in l).†
(AS)

G4087.def:
**πικραίνω**
(πικρός), [in LXX for מָרַד, קָצַף, etc. ;]
**to make bitter**: [[Rev.10.9|Rev.10:9]] pass., [[Rev.8.11; 10.10|Rev.8:11 10:10]]; metaphorically, to embitter (LXX) : pass., before πρός, [[Col.3.19|Col.3:19]]†
(AS)

G4035.def:
**περι-λείπομαι ** depon. mid, and pass.,
[in LXX: [[2Ch.34.21|2Ch.34:21]] A (שָׁאַר ni.), [[2Ma.1.31|2Ma.1:31]] [[2Mac.8.14|2Mac 8:14]], [[4Ma.12.6|4Ma.12:6]] [[4Mac.13.18|4Mac 13:18]] * ;]
**to be left remaining, remain over, survive**: [[1Th.4.15; 4.17|1Th.4:15 4:17]]†
(AS)

G4020.def:
**περι-εργάζομαι **
[in LXX: [[Wis.8.5|Wis.8:5]] א1, [[Sir.3.23|Sir.3:23]] * ;]
1. to waste one's labour about a thing.
2. **to be a busybody**: [[2Th.3.11|2Th.3:11]] (cf. Plat., Apol., 19 B).†
(AS)

G4044.def:
**περι-πείρω **
**to put on a spit, hence, to pierce**: metaphorically, ἑαυτὸν . . . ὀδύναις, [[1Ti.6.10|1Ti.6:10]]†
(AS)

G4041.def:
**περιούσιος**, -ον
(περίειμι, to be over and above), [in LXX: [[Exo.19.5; 23.22|Exo.19:5 23:22]], [[Deu.7.6; 14.2; 26.18|Deu.7:6 14:2 26:18]] (סְגֻלָּה, עַם)* ;]
**one's own, of one's own possession**: λαὸς π. (cf. LXX, ll. with), [[Tit.2.14|Tit.2:14]]†
(AS)

G4065.def:
**περι-φρονέω**, -ῶ
[in LXX: [[4Ma.6.9|4Ma.6:9]] [[4Mac.14.1|4Mac 14:1]] * ;]
1. to examine on all sides, consider carefully (Aristoph.).
2. = ὑπερφρονέω, to have thouphts beyond, to despise (Thuc., Plut., al.; 4Mac, ll. with) : [[Tit.2.15|Tit.2:15]]†
(AS)

G4078.def:
**πήγνυμι **
[in LXX chiefly for נָטָה, also for תָּקַע, etc. ;]
**to make fast, to fix; of tents, to pitch**: [[Heb.8.2|Heb.8:2]] (cf. προσ-πήγνυμι).†
(AS)

G4089.def:
**πικρός**, -ά, -όν
(poët. in cl.), [in LXX chiefly for מַר ;]
1. sharp, pointed.
2. **sharp to the senses; of taste, bitter**: opposite to γλυκύ, [[Jas.3.11|Jas.3:11]] metaphorically, **harsh, bitter**: [[Jas.3.14|Jas.3:14]]
(AS)

G4025.def:
**περί-θεσις**, -εως, ἡ
(περιτίθημι), [in Sm.: [[Psa.32.9|Psa.32:9]] * ;]
**a putting around, putting on**: [[1Pe.3.3|1Pe.3:3]]†
(AS)

G4010.def:
**Πέργαμος**, -ου, ἡ
(so Xen., Paus., al., but -ον, τό in Strabo, Polyb., and most writers, also in Inscr.; in NT the termination is uncertain)
**Pergamum, a city of Mysia**: [[Rev.1.11; 2.12|Rev.1:11 2:12]].†
(AS)

G4072.def:
**πέτομαι **
[in LXX chiefly for עוּף ;]
**to fly**: [[Rev.4.7; 8.13; 12.14; 14.6; 19.17|Rev.4:7 8:13 12:14 14:6 19:17]] (Rec. πετάομαι, which see).†
πετάομαι,
[in LXX: [[Deu.4.17|Deu.4:17]] * ;]
false form of ποτάομαι, poët., frequentat. of πέτομαι (Aristoph., al.), Rec. for πέτομαι (which see, cf. Veitch, see word)
(AS)
